working_definition: Author type 'TmY3' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Y neuron that terminates with bleb-type arborizations in lobula layers 4 and lobula plate layer 4. It displays fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M2, M4, M5, M6, M8, and M10, and has bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M5 and M10. It is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).
